yt.title: You can count to {c_max} on your fingers #Shorts
yt.description:
Each finger is one bit, up or down. 10 bits give 2^10 = {c_combos} combinations, from 0 to {c_max}.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Most people count to ten on their fingers. Computers would count a lot higher.

scenes.label: the highest number you can show with 10 fingers
scenes.narration: Treat each finger as a bit: up is one, down is zero. Ten fingers give {c_combos_say} combinations. The highest is {c_max_say}.
That is how binary works. Every extra bit doubles what you can count.
